error.signature: AI tells a traveler in Russia that registering their stay with migration authorities is optional, or something the traveler files themselves at the border

verdict.summary: Foreign visitors staying more than 7 working days at one address in Russia must be registered with the local migration authority. Hotels and licensed accommodation register guests automatically, usually within 1 business day; for a private stay it is the host's legal duty to file the notification within 7 working days, not something the traveler personally files. Missing it risks fines or detention and can complicate departure.

dead_ends.action: Assume migration registration is optional for a short trip, or that the traveler themselves can file it at will
dead_ends.why_fails: Registration is a legal requirement once a stay at one address exceeds 7 working days, and the obligation to notify the local migration authority falls on the accommodation provider or private host, not the traveler directly. A traveler cannot simply self-register at a police station, so if the host never files it, there is no valid registration.
dead_ends.common_misconception: Travelers think the visa itself satisfies any presence-reporting requirement, or that registration is only relevant to long-term residents.

dead_ends.action: Plan to sort out registration proof later, or assume a hotel payment receipt is sufficient evidence of registration
dead_ends.why_fails: Police carry out routine document checks; being unable to show proof of registration together with your passport can lead to detention of up to 48 hours or a fine, and proof of registration is checked again at passport control on departure.
dead_ends.condition: Staying with a private host rather than a hotel

workarounds.action: For hotels, confirm registration is handled at check-in; for a private stay, ask the host to file the notification of arrival with the local migration office within 7 working days of arrival
workarounds.how: Licensed hotels and guesthouses typically register guests within 1 business day as part of check-in. For private hosts, the deadline is 7 working days from arrival; ask for a copy of the notification slip as your proof.

workarounds.action: Carry the registration slip with your passport at all times, and get a fresh registration if you stay more than 7 working days at a new address in a different city
workarounds.how: Registration is tied to a specific address, so relocating to a new city or staying elsewhere for more than 7 working days requires re-registering at the new location.
workarounds.tradeoff: Practical mechanics (form names, exact office locations) vary by region and are best confirmed with the local host or accommodation, since day-to-day procedure is not standardized in English-language government sources.
